about: The trailer narration, in order. One audio file per line, named by 'file'. tools/make_voice.py makes and judges them; tools/trailer_edit.py places them. 'speed' (optional) slows or quickens one line of the AI voice.

lines.text: This is Tallow. Tallow is a candle.
At midnight, the house wakes up.
His wax is his health. His wax is also his clock.
Every hit melts him faster. Every win buys him time.
Be done by two... or burn out trying.
Wax and Wane. Light the wick.
